name: Swindle
source:
Seiji comes back to his hometown after an interval of five years. What he remembers is Sakura, his childhood friend. He still loves her. He is transferred to Sakura's class, and he confirms his unchanged love toward Sakura, even though she has a boyfriend, Enji. One day, Sakura and Enji get involved in a traffic accident, and taken to hospital. Seiji rushes into her hospital room. When she hears his voice, she says, "Enji...?" She has lost her sight....

[From Erogeshop]
translation:
誠司時隔五年回到故鄉。他記憶中最深刻的人，是青梅竹馬櫻。時至今日，他仍然愛著她。誠司轉入櫻所在的班級；儘管櫻已有一名叫炎司的男朋友，他還是明白，自己對她的感情從未改變。一天，櫻與炎司出了車禍，被送往醫院。誠司匆忙趕進她的病房。聽到他的聲音後，櫻說道：「炎司……？」她已經失去了視力……

[摘自Erogeshop]
